_comment: The closed classes of a failed managed Ollama runtime install (OLL-04 and OLL-05 of docs/audits/platform-parity/2026-11-20-managed-ollama/report.md). Each driver writes one evidence line for a failure, closed words and the native error text: Windows `stage=<s> reason=<r> <exception type> hresult=0x<8 hex> [win32=<n>] <message>` (ollama_managed_files.ps1 Get-OllamaFailureEvidence), macOS `phase=<download|install> reason=<r> [errno=<NAME>]` (managed_ollama_runtime.py install_failure_evidence, printed after OLLAMA_INSTALL_FAILURE), Linux `<installer reason> <download or extraction error> [curl_exit=<n>]` (_shared/ai/engine/ollama/archive_installer.lua). A class is the first row whose needle the lowercased evidence contains; none is `unknown`. Disk and permission come first, since a full disk also fails the download; cancellation before integrity, integrity before the network, which catches what is left of a transfer. `curl exit 23` is curl's write error: with the free-space check done before the download, it is a disk that filled during it. Read by _shared/ai/engine/ollama/install_errors.lua (macOS and Linux) and windows/ai/engine/ollama/install_errors.ahk; replayed from _shared/tests/corpus/llm/ollama_install_error_vectors.json by the three suites. `messages` is the locale key each class shows. `pull` names the model pull classes of ollama_pull_errors.json that are an install class too, since a full disk is the same cause whether the runtime or a model fills it (OLL-14); a failed pull of such a class shows that class's `pull_messages` key, the model tag in its %s, and every other pull class keeps the generic pull failure. The free-space rule: the pinned asset's bytes and unpacked_bytes (ollama_release.json, measured by tools/build/pin-ollama-release.cjs; managed_ollama_release.json on macOS, measured by its producer) plus [limits] ollama_install_free_space_margin_bytes of _shared/core/timing/data/constants.toml must be free before the download starts: the archive stays until its extraction ends.
